footer.description: A Vue 3 starter with Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and shadcn-vue, all set up.

hero.title: Everything a Vue app starts with.
hero.description: A Vue 3 starter on Vite 8 with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4 and shadcn-vue. Routing, state, i18n, PWA and linting are already set up.

cta.title: Start your next Vue app.
cta.description: Create a repository from the template, or copy the project with one command.

components.title: Components you own.
components.description: shadcn-vue copies accessible Reka UI components into src/components/ui, styled with Tailwind CSS 4. One command adds another.

card.title: Notifications
card.description: Choose how you hear about updates.

dev.title: Ready in a blink.
dev.description: Vite 8 runs on Rolldown. The dev server comes with Vue DevTools, Inspect and an MCP server for AI assistants.

theming.title: Light by day. Dark by night.
theming.description: Follows the system theme or the visitor's choice, and the new theme spreads in a circle from the click. Try it here.

state.title: State that stays.
state.description: Pinia stores keep their values from page to page. Count up here, then open the counter page.

pwa.title: Installs like an app.
pwa.description: vite-plugin-pwa adds the manifest and a service worker that updates itself. Once visited, the site works offline.
pwa.production: Service worker runs in production builds

i18n.title: Every language, one codebase.
i18n.description: Messages live in src/locales as JSON and are compiled at build time. The language picker remembers each visitor's choice.

sample.title: Kirk invited you
sample.body: Join the boot-vue project on GitHub.

autoImport.title: No import lines.
autoImport.description: Vue, Vue Router, vue-i18n and VueUse, your own composables and stores, components and icons are imported for you, fully typed.

typography.title: Punctuation, set right.
typography.description: Latin text uses the system UI font, while Chinese quotation marks, dashes and ellipses take the Chinese font, with Chinese shapes and spacing.
typography.label: Font stack

deploy.title: Ship it anywhere.
deploy.description: Deploy to Netlify or Vercel in a few clicks, or build a Docker image served by nginx.

stack.title: Built on the modern web.
stack.description: Vue 3.5, Vite 8, TypeScript 6 and Tailwind CSS 4, with Pinia, VueUse, Vitest, pnpm and ESLint already set up.

store.title: Shared across pages.
store.description: This count lives in a Pinia store, the same one the home page uses. Count up here, then go back.

error.title: Page not found
error.description: The page you are looking for doesn't exist or has been moved.
